_summary: Declares the Software project pack: artifacts, evidence, review lenses, completion requirements, and tool probes for software projects.
name: Software
summary: The default pack for applications, services, libraries, and command-line tools. It expects a repository, builds, tests, and a first phase that installs, starts, and completes one real user action.

artifacts.name: Source code
artifacts.description: Application, library, or tool code in the repository.

artifacts.name: Tests
artifacts.description: Automated tests and the commands that run them.

artifacts.name: Documentation
artifacts.description: README, setup instructions, and user or developer documentation.

typical_stages: First working path: install, start, and complete one real user action

evidence.name: build
evidence.description: The project's build command exits successfully.

evidence.name: unit-tests
evidence.description: The project's automated test command exits successfully.

evidence.name: lint
evidence.description: The project's formatter or linter reports no errors.

evidence.name: dependency-audit
evidence.description: A dependency vulnerability and license check reports no unresolved problem.

evidence.name: security-scan
evidence.description: A security scanner already used by the project reports no unresolved high finding.

evidence.name: user-journey
evidence.description: A person completes the phase's main user action and records the result.

evidence.name: accessibility-check
evidence.description: User-facing screens and output are checked against WCAG 2.2 Level AA where applicable.

evidence.name: documentation-check
evidence.description: Setup and usage documentation match the behavior shipped in the phase.

evidence.name: license-check
evidence.description: New dependencies and copied material are compatible with the project's license and carry their notices.

review_lenses.name: Correctness and reliability
review_lenses.focus: Behavior matches the accepted decisions and plan; failure handling, recovery, and edge cases are covered by evidence.

review_lenses.name: Security and privacy
review_lenses.focus: Input validation, command and query construction, permissions, credentials, personal data, and dependency risks.

review_lenses.name: Accessibility and user experience
review_lenses.focus: Keyboard use, labels, contrast, error messages, and plain-language output for user-facing surfaces.

review_lenses.name: Maintainability, documentation, licensing, and release readiness
review_lenses.focus: Readable code, current documentation, headers and notices, license compatibility, and packaging.

completion: Every required evidence item for the phase has a current record tied to the exact revision reviewed.
Both phase reviewers approved, or the user accepted a recorded reduced-assurance decision.
The plan revision reflects every accepted change, TODO, deviation, skipped check, and deferral.
The first phase installs, starts, and completes one real user action.
